'''International relations'''
*[[2023 visit by Volodymyr Zelenskyy to Europe]]
**[[President of Ukraine|Ukrainian President]] [[Volodymyr Zelenskyy]] meets with [[Prime Minister of the United Kingdom|British Prime Minister]] [[Rishi Sunak]] at [[Chequers]]. [https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/live/world-europe-65595035 (BBC News)]

'''Law and crime'''
*[[China–United States relations]]
**[[China]] convicts and sentences [[United States of America|American]] citizen John Shing-Wan Leung to life in prison for espionage. [https://apnews.com/article/american-charged-spying-china-prison-2de86767bbc828ec4362af23fb271afd (AP)]
*[[Capital punishment in Malaysia]]
**The [[government of Malaysia]] announces that it will introduce a bill to decriminalize the possession and use of small quantities of [[illicit drugs]] after ending the mandatory imposition of a [[death sentence]] for drug trafficking earlier this year. [https://www.reuters.com/world/asia-pacific/malaysia-seeks-decriminalise-possession-use-small-amounts-drugs-2023-05-15/ (Reuters)]
*[[2023 Farmington, New Mexico shooting]]
**Three civilians are killed and two police officers are injured in a [[mass shooting]] in [[Farmington, New Mexico]], [[United States]]. The shooter is killed by police. [https://www.cnn.com/2023/05/15/us/farmington-new-mexico-shooting/index.html (CNN)]
